synopsis: Siân Berry is the Green Party MP for Brighton Pavilion, and has been an MP continually since 4 July 2024. She currently undertakes the roles of Green Spokesperson (Justice), Green Spokesperson (Transport), Green Spokesperson (Work and Pensions), Green Spokesperson (Democratic Standards), Green Party Chief Whip, and Green Spokesperson (Home).
